name: @mpgd/example-lite-starter
description: Lite (no Phaser) starter: @mpgd/lite-shell Canvas2D renderer with optional lazy matter-js.

scripts.dev:ait: APP_TARGET=ait MPGD_CONFIG_TARGET=ait MPGD_PLATFORM_TARGETS_FILE=./mpgd.targets.json APP_VERSION=0.0.0-dev BUILD_ID=ait-sandbox sh -c 'pnpm --dir ../.. i18n:build && vite --host 0.0.0.0'
scripts.icons:generate: pnpm exec mpgd game icons generate . --kit-path ${MPGD_KIT_PATH:-../..}
scripts.icons:generate:devvit: pnpm exec mpgd game icons generate . --targets reddit --profile development --kit-path ${MPGD_KIT_PATH:-../..}
scripts.icons:generate:devvit:production: pnpm exec mpgd game icons generate . --targets reddit --profile production --kit-path ${MPGD_KIT_PATH:-../..}
scripts.icons:verify: pnpm exec mpgd game icons verify . --kit-path ${MPGD_KIT_PATH:-../..}
scripts.icons:inspect: pnpm exec mpgd game icons inspect . --kit-path ${MPGD_KIT_PATH:-../..}
scripts.build:ait: pnpm exec mpgd target build ait staging --variant wrapper --targets-file ./mpgd.targets.json --kit-path ${MPGD_KIT_PATH:-../..}
scripts.build:ait:package: pnpm exec mpgd target build ait production --targets-file ./mpgd.targets.json --kit-path ${MPGD_KIT_PATH:-../..}
scripts.smoke:ait: pnpm exec mpgd target smoke ait --targets-file ./mpgd.targets.json --kit-path ${MPGD_KIT_PATH:-../..}
scripts.build:verse8: pnpm exec mpgd target build verse8 production --targets-file ./mpgd.targets.json --kit-path ${MPGD_KIT_PATH:-../..}
scripts.smoke:verse8: pnpm exec mpgd target smoke verse8 --targets-file ./mpgd.targets.json --kit-path ${MPGD_KIT_PATH:-../..}
scripts.build:devvit: pnpm exec mpgd target build reddit production --targets-file ./mpgd.targets.json --kit-path ${MPGD_KIT_PATH:-../..}
scripts.build:devvit:staging: pnpm exec mpgd target build reddit staging --targets-file ./mpgd.targets.json --kit-path ${MPGD_KIT_PATH:-../..}
scripts.smoke:devvit: pnpm exec mpgd target smoke reddit --targets-file ./mpgd.targets.json --kit-path ${MPGD_KIT_PATH:-../..}
scripts.pages:build: pnpm legal:build && pnpm --dir apps/target-cloudflare-pages run build
scripts.pages:dev: pnpm legal:build && pnpm --dir apps/target-cloudflare-pages run dev
scripts.pages:preview: pnpm legal:build && pnpm --dir apps/target-cloudflare-pages run preview
scripts.format: ttsc format -p tsconfig.json && ttsc format -p tsconfig.tools.json
scripts.fix: ttsc fix -p tsconfig.json && ttsc fix -p tsconfig.tools.json
